title: Staff Vacancies
metaDescription: Current teaching and support staff vacancies at Rosehill College, Papakura. See open roles, requirements and how to apply to join our team.

sections.heading: Join Our Team at Rosehill College
sections.lede: Explore exciting career opportunities at Rosehill College, where we are committed to fostering a dynamic and supportive environment for both students and staff. Whether you are passionate about teaching, administration, or support roles, we invite you to be a part of our vibrant educational community and contribute to the success and growth of our students.

sections.heading: How to Apply
sections.html:
The terms and conditions, including base salary, for teaching positions are set by the Secondary Teachers’ Collective Agreement. The base salary for trained and registered teachers ranges from $62,862 to $105,686, depending on the applicant’s qualifications and experience. An individual’s actual base salary will be established through a salary assessment once a position is confirmed.

A Rosehill College Application Form must accompany your CV and cover letter:

* [Application Form — Teachers](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1miND8DSPlA6e7gO_ERSzjtMx1Dqex9xi/view)
* [Application Form — Relief Teachers](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NVlwVmamPH2Oz3gNWFHPTuK_JfZ_cqSw/view)
* [Application Form — Support Staff](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Wi2jvSdskRLpeZpBWdD8TYesLclYjwD9/view)

sections.heading: Current Vacancies
sections.html:
#### **Science & Senior Biology Teacher · Full Time/Permanent · Start date: Beginning of Term 1 2027** We seek a collaborative and passionate teacher of Science and Senior Biology to join our Science faculty. **Applicants should have a current New Zealand teacher registration and a current work permit or equivalent.** The successful candidate will have: * the ability to inspire and challenge students across the curriculum from year 9 through to year 13 * the ability to teach **senior Biology** * a clear understanding of NCEA and the New Zealand curriculum. * experience in differentiated teaching at the junior and senior levels * ability to work collaboratively and use reflective practice to raise student achievement * knowledge of the principles of Te Tiriti o Waitangi and ensure te reo me ōna Tikanga are upheld * relational practices to tautoko positive, mana-enhancing relationships within our kura A commitment to mana ōrite mō te mātauranga māori, and cultural responsiveness is also essential. Posted Date: 25 September 2026
#### **HOD Food Technology and Hospitality 2 MU · Full Time/Permanent · Start date: As soon as available** We are seeking a well organised, innovative and inspiring leader of Food Technology and Hospitality. The successful candidate will be able to raise student achievement with a focus on student wellbeing and positive learning relationships. **Applicants should have a current New Zealand teacher registration and a working knowledge of the New Zealand curriculum. The successful candidate will have:** * a genuine passion for teaching and a clear understanding of NCEA * experience in designing programmes of work * experience in the assessment of Achievement Standards * experience in differentiated teaching at the junior and senior levels * ability to lead a team to work collaboratively to raise student achievement * knowledge of the principles of Te Tiriti o Waitangi and ensure te reo me ōna Tikanga are upheld * relational practices to tautoko positive relationships within our kura A commitment to mana ōrite mō te mātauranga māori, and cultural responsiveness is also essential. ***Applicants must have NZ working rights.*** Posted Date: 26 August 2026

sections.text: Discover the current vacancies and take the next step in your professional journey with us. Questions about a role or an application? We would love to hear from you.
